area: Cottonwood Road and Watts Drive, Bakersfield
summary: Working fire assignment at the Cottonwood Road and Watts Drive intersection, bringing multiple engines and a battalion chief to the scene. Additional callers reported smoke in the area, which crews confirmed was the same incident.

area: Shell Street and Ethel Street, Bakersfield
summary: Working fire behind a brick wall at Shell Street and Ethel Street, with the fire reported large in size. Multiple engines, a truck company and a battalion chief were assigned.

area: White Lane and Old River Road, southwest Bakersfield
summary: Officers broadcast an officer-safety warning of shots in the central area of White Lane and Old River Road.
Fire 2 assignment for a fire outside the Golden West Casino on South Union Avenue, with multiple engines, a rescue unit and a battalion chief responding.
Shots heard reported in the Pepperwood Drive area; a witness located a spent casing in a driveway and was interviewed.
A reported stabbing that had just occurred; a nearby unit was requested for the call.
A man with a machete was reported attempting to break into a business on Union Avenue; he was later located hiding near a dumpster and taken into custody.
Caller reported people in a homeless encampment believed to be setting each other's camps on fire; responders were told to treat it as a fire only if flames were seen.
Report that a man shoved his wife to the floor; additional callers in the area were being located.
Possible child-endangerment situation in which a girlfriend was heard screaming and furniture being thrown was reported.
Medical aid for a reported overdose on Bernard Street; the patient was described as not breathing.
A pursuit continued north just past Highway 46, with units reporting updates becoming sparse as it left the area.
Domestic disturbance involving an ex-boyfriend, with a young child present.

area: Interstate 5 north of the 138, Kern County
summary: A silver Hyundai was reported driving northbound on Interstate 5; a DUI-related broadcast was put out for the vehicle.
Medical aid at a Walmart pharmacy on Tucker Road.
Welfare check on a toddler seen running in and out of a Calloway Avenue business; multiple adults were reported with the child.
Vegetation fire reported spreading across roughly an acre, surrounded by roads with crews working to make access.
Disturbance with a female reportedly asking for help and loud screaming heard nearby.
Priority-1 active disturbance with multiple subjects on El Rancho Drive.
Report at a busy intersection on Pittsfield Street; the caller was unable to provide suspect information.
A vehicle was reported unoccupied in the middle of the street, with units confirming contact with the reporting party.
Medical aid for a reported overdose; the patient was not violent and no weapon was involved.
An in-progress call at a California Avenue business; a man was reported running from the scene toward a black Audi.
Medical aid for difficulty breathing on 8th Street.
A female reported being hit by a male during a domestic call.
A vehicle was reported stopped in the middle of the roadway on White Street.
Domestic dispute in which a foster father was refusing to let a juvenile back inside the residence.
A vehicle showing as repossessed was located, with its registration suspended.
Medical aid for difficulty breathing on Idlerock Avenue.
Medical aid for ill patients on Oak Garden Lane.
Medical aid for difficulty breathing on Cardinal Avenue.
Medical aid for stroke symptoms on South Mill Street.
